text: Staff in Corporate Finance will provide information on financial mechanisms that might be applied to offer tax rebates or relief to help ensure the long-term sustainability of live music venues in Toronto. Staff in Economic Development and Culture will present strategies to maintain and create new accessible, sustainable spaces for Toronto's creative sector.

The Toronto Music Advisory Committee recommends that: 1. The Economic and Community Development Committee request the General Manager, Economic Development and Culture to: a. Establish an interdivisional working group, including Economic Development and Culture, Corporate Finance, City Planning and other necessary city staff; and b. Report to the Toronto Music Advisory Committee on February 20, 2020 and to the Economic and Community Development Committee with a review and steps to develop a rebate program for live music venues, and other financial options to support live music in the City of Toronto.
